engine.description: The always-on machine where the work runs: repositories, sessions, dev servers and services

client.description: Any other machine the developer works from; it reaches the engine and can fall back to working locally

session.description: A named, long-running terminal session on the engine holding Claude Code and a git tab, one per checkout

project.description: A repository registered with the tool

checkout.description: A working copy of a project on disk: its main clone or a sibling worktree on its own branch

editor.description: The code editor a session's worktree is opened in, on the machine the developer is at

category.description: A label a project is grouped under in the program's own configuration; it never moves anything on disk

root.description: A folder on the engine tied to one GitHub owner and the account that lists it; that owner's repositories are cloned into it
